rationale: C25 is expressly incorporated into the child: section 1(a) makes C25's Part II coordination procedures applicable to Agriculture personnel assigned abroad. The child's section 1(b) then restates and adapts C25's substantive machinery—foreign-policy direction by the Secretary of State, interagency coordination, and leadership by the Chief of Mission. This is direct, concrete, and material template use. C04 and C03 are weaker parallels concerning Foreign Service allowances and authorities, but neither matches the child's coordination framework as directly.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The provisions of Part II—Procedures for Coordination Abroad—of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of November 6, 1954, shall be applicable to the official activities of persons assigned abroad
shared_material.parent_excerpt: PART II. PROCEDURES FOR COORDINATION ABROAD
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly extends C25's named operative part to a new category of personnel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: official activities ... are carried on consonant with United States foreign-policy objectives as defined by the Secretary of State and are effectively coordinated with the activities of representatives of other United States agencies, under the leadership of the Chief of the United States Diplomatic Mission
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Chief of the United States Diplomatic Mission ... shall provide foreign policy direction to all representatives of United States agencies ... [and] shall coordinate the activities of the representatives of United States agencies
shared_material.explanation: The child substantially condenses and adapts C25's central foreign-policy direction and Chief-of-Mission coordination machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary of Agriculture shall issue instructions on agricultural matters to persons assigned abroad
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subject to compliance with the provisions of this part and with the prescribed procedures of their respective agencies, all representatives ... shall have direct communication with their respective agencies
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves agency-specific instruction while subjecting personnel to C25's country-level coordination regime.
